# Grandet

> Grandet helps users find affordable model APIs. The live website provides price and supplier evidence; Grandet Price Finder Skill 0.3.0 brings this workflow into agents. Grandet Personal is a desktop client in private beta, with no public installer. This repository also preserves the dated catalogue of 73 official programmes, 34 third-party mechanisms and 642 structured prerequisites.

## Install Grandet Price Finder
- https://github.com/hanzohanzhe/Grandet/blob/main/INSTALL.md : persistent installation instructions; use the official repository directly, without requiring a private attachment
- https://github.com/hanzohanzhe/Grandet/tree/main/skills/grandet-api-price-finder : complete canonical Skill source
- https://github.com/hanzohanzhe/Grandet/raw/refs/heads/main/downloads/grandet-api-price-finder-0.3.0.zip : portable installation package
- https://github.com/hanzohanzhe/Grandet/raw/refs/heads/main/downloads/grandet-api-price-finder-0.3.0.skill : native Skill import package
- https://grandet.ai/public-data/price-finder.json : current website machine contract
- https://grandet.ai/mcp : anonymous Streamable HTTP MCP tools

Install once in the intended agent's persistent scope. Later API price, supplier, quality, speed or stability questions should select the Skill naturally; callers need not mention Grandet. Each host's support and acceptance status is documented in the installation guide. Never treat an available installation route as proof of native testing. Querying published prices requires no Grandet login or API key. Price declarations and supplier statements do not prove model quality or identity.

- https://github.com/hanzohanzhe/Grandet

- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzohanzhe/Grandet/main/DATA-LICENSE.md : source rights

## Interpretation
Compilation date: 2026-10-06. Per-record checkedAt/observedAt and evidence dates are original observations, not refreshed dates. Read all conditions, billingText, requirements and evidence links before summarizing. Unknown does not mean no requirement. Original units are not converted to tokens or cash. Provider statements are not tested personal eligibility, upstream quality or successful redemption. Status depends on time and provider terms; retained records may be historical. This is finite researched coverage, not an exhaustive directory.

## Publication status
Public website: https://grandet.ai . Current acceptance metadata: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzohanzhe/Grandet/main/WEBSITE-STATUS.json . Prior data release manifests retain their original publication-time status. Desktop client/installer and entire website source are not released here. No automatic updates are enabled.

GitHub raw access and public visibility do not guarantee search/AI indexing. GitHub code search covers indexed default-branch code and requires sign-in; prefer direct raw URLs. See https://docs.github.com/en/search-github/github-code-search/about-github-code-search and https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/creating-and-managing-repositories/repository-limits .
